# RAINCLOUD

> RAINCLOUD is a done-for-you B2B pipeline system for companies with $50M to $200M in revenue. Built on the client's existing CRM and run by RAINCLOUD, it starts with a $5,000 100-Point GTM Autopsy, then a $25,000 Build, then $10,000 a month on a six-month minimum. Founded by Colin Dowling.

RAINCLOUD was founded by Colin Dowling, a 3x VP of Sales, a 2x founder and the host of Modern Business Life. His roles include VP Global Enterprise Sales at GoDaddy, SVP Revenue at Alembic (Seed to $145M Series B), VP Channel Sales at Liquid Web and Enterprise Sales Director at WP Engine. Colin personally runs every 100-Point GTM Autopsy and every monthly operating review. RAINCLOUD takes four clients at a time.

## The offer, in order

1. 20 Minute Teardown. Free. The Outside-In GTM Teardown: 40 of the 100 points, scored from public sources. Book: https://rncld.com/teardown/ or https://calendly.com/30minutechat/20-minute-go-to-market-w-colin
2. 100-Point GTM Autopsy. $5,000. Every point is pass, partial or fail. Findings ranked by revenue impact, ten highest-impact gaps first. Five business days from access granted, then one recorded 90-minute walkthrough. Required. Credited in full against the Build. The report is the build specification. No cash refund. The paid Autopsy is the trial.
3. The Build. $25,000 ($20,000 net of the audit credit). 30 business days to go-live: access, domains and mailboxes, warmup, TAM, CRM mapping, content plan, first sequences live.
4. Ongoing operation. $10,000 per month, six-month minimum from go-live, billed quarterly in advance (two payments of $30,000). Three channels (mass email, bottom-of-funnel content, signal outbound), a governance layer that suppresses against the live CRM on every send, reporting, and infrastructure included.

Total for the first seven months: $85,000.

If the agreed day-90 pipeline target is missed, RAINCLOUD keeps running the system at no charge until it is hit. Qualified opportunities, not meetings. Qualified is defined in the client's words, set jointly by day 30 of the Build.

The 100-Point GTM Framework is free at https://rncld.com/resources/100-point-gtm-framework.html. Clients do not self-score. The scoring is the service.

Hard gate: CRM access, domains registered in the company's name, sending-domain approval, and a named point of contact, all within ten business days of signature. If that slips, the build clock and the agreed day-90 pipeline target move.

## Alongside the program

- GTM consulting. $2,000 per month. One hour a week. No execution. Does not route through the 100-Point GTM Autopsy. https://rncld.com/gtm-consulting.html
- BoFu Baby. A separate site. https://bofubaby.com No price is stated here.

## Who it is for

B2B companies between $50M and $200M in revenue with average contract value around $50,000 or higher. The buyer is a CRO, VP Sales, VP Marketing, or a founder still close to revenue. Not a fit: ACV under about $50,000 with low deal volume, no maintained CRM, a heavily customised Salesforce with a protective RevOps team, no domain control, or buying a trial rather than a system.

## Results

- AgentPress: 7 to 25+ meetings a month. "The real secret sauce has been hiring Colin Dowling and RAINCLOUD, who helped us go from 7 meetings a month to more than 25 in a single month." Andy Walters, Founder + CEO, AgentPress.
- 1905 New Media: digital services from $4M to $11M over two years.

## What RAINCLOUD is not

Not a SaaS product and not a seat that manages reps. Earlier versions of this site sold a 90-day rebuild, advisory, and a scorecard tier. Those are retired. RAINCLOUD builds and runs pipeline: a free 20 Minute Teardown, a 100-Point GTM Autopsy, a 30-business-day Build, and Ongoing operation. BoFu Baby is https://bofubaby.com.
